subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo — cross-region coverage options
messages:
From: Danielle Park <danielle@horizonsense.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: HorizonSense Sales Ops <salesops@horizonsense.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 20:03:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — Wed or Thu next week?

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the intro. Wed love to see Redwood in action. Our team in SF is available next week in the late afternoon PST. Would you be able to do Wednesday 17 Nov at 5:00 PM PT (wed like ~60 minutes)? That should work for all our stakeholders here.

Quick notes: we have engineers, product, and our security lead on the call. If possible, can you include any materials (brief agenda + security checklist) beforehand?

Appreciate it — Danielle

Attachments: horizonsense-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf, 92KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@horizonsense.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 07:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Wed or Thu next week?

Hi Danielle — great to hear. Quick flag on cross-region timing: 5:00 PM PT on Wed is 2:00 AM CET for our EU team, so that would be very late for the folks we'd like to include (product & infra folks in Berlin).

Two practical options wed see working:
- Option A: early morning PT (e.g., 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET) which lets our full EU product/infra team join live; 60 minutes and a follow-up Q&A with any regional stakeholders who need a separate sync.
- Option B: keep 17:00 PT for your team and we run a US-only-focused demo (condensed 45-min) and record the session; a follow-up deep-dive with EU engineers could be scheduled the next morning CET.

Wed also propose a hybrid approach: Marissa leads the live demo timed for EU participation, record it, then Hannah hosts a short, US-friendly follow-up 30-min Q&A at a time that fits your West Coast team. That avoids late-night for EU and gives your stakeholders a live Q&A in their hours.

Im looping in Marissa and Hannah to confirm availability and to propose concrete slots. I attached a draft agenda and will add a tentative invite once we agree on a slot.

Thanks,
Sergio

--

sergio@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks for the ping. I can cover the main demo for EU participation. Practical availability: Im free 16:0017:30 CET on Wed 18 Nov or Thu 19 Nov. 16:00 CET would be 07:00 PT the same day for the SF teams morning.

Notes:
- EU clocks have already moved back to CET, and the US clocks changed earlier in November, so small offsets can trip people up — we should be explicit in invite times with both zones listed (e.g., "08:00 PT / 17:00 CET").
- Im happy to record the session for anyone who cant attend live.

Ill attach a brief internal checklist (internal-demo-coverage.docx) with proposed split of topics (overview, latency/cost, deployment modes, security/Q&A).

-Marissa

Hi all,

Thanks for the options. Our preference would actually be a single block that covers everything so our whole team hears the same thing. 5:00 PM PT (Wed) is the most convenient for our stakeholders calendars. If running live at 5pm PT would be painful for your EU team, we can do a slightly condensed 45-minute demo starting 5:00 PM PT (we can push detailed infra/security questions to a separate session).

That said, if the EU team's presence is important for topics like deployment patterns and quantization recommendations, wed rather pick an earlier single slot where they can join live. If youre recommending 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET, we can do that but would prefer the sooner of the two days (Wed 18 Nov) if Marissa can lead.

Also: please include the security checklist and any SOC/SLA one-pagers in advance.

Best,
Danielle
